A '''clone trooper''' served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He<ref name="Tethan" /> was created on<ref name="Clone Databank" /> the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], and like all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], he was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] who stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the clone trooper was present on the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]<ref name="Tethan" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="TEA" /> where the Republic was [[Battle of Teth/Legends|fighting]] against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|That trooper displayed more courage than you'll ever be capable of!|A youngling, to Asajj Ventress in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
The clone trooper appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books.<ref name="Tethan" />
